reason: 该插件主要用于为 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面承载端补充更完整的右键上下文菜单交互，以会话/工作区/对话界面为核心场景并通过应用服务执行复制、路径与链接打开等操作，因此可归类为界面导航与面板交互增强。

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面封装端提供更完整的原生风格右键菜单，支持会话、工作区和对话区域的常见操作与扩展入口。
summaries.en: Provides a richer native-style context menu for DeepSeek Harness desktop wrapper interfaces, covering sessions, workspaces, and conversation areas with common actions and extension hooks.

capabilities: Provides custom context menus across session, workspace, settings, conversation output, and input contexts
Performs copy/paste/edit actions (cut/copy/paste/undo/redo/select all) via browser/host capabilities
Opens local paths and URLs through host/workspace runtime services
Registers extension hooks and dispatches context-menu event payloads for other plugins

reasons.code: README describes an enhanced right-click experience for DeepSeek Harness desktop-wrapped clients, covering session, workspace, settings, conversation, link, and input contexts.
Built-in context actions include copying selected text, open path, copy directory/session ID, open links, and editing actions for input fields.

Compatibility notes state the plugin calls POST /api/host.openPath for directory opening and uses workspaces.openPath for links, and handles clipboard fallback behavior when writable access is unavailable.

package.json declares runtime client injection under web platform and depends on DeepSeek Harness runtime/workspace packages, indicating integration with application services rather than standalone execution.
